metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Ruled out for Week 4
metadata.description: Legette (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday night's game against the Lions, Alex Zietlow of The Charlotte Observer reports.
metadata.analysis: Legette will miss a second straight game, and with Jalen Coker (quadriceps) listed questionable, the Panthers could be forced to dip even deeper into their wide receiver depth after Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie played heavy snaps in Week 3 against Cleveland.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Ruled Out for Week 4
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette (knee) has been ruled out for Week 4's matchup against the Detroit Lions. After missing all of practice this week, Legette will miss his second straight week due to the knee injury. In two games this season, he has caught two of six targets for 64 yards, playing 53% of snaps and running 61% of routes. With Legette out and Jalen Coker (quad) questionable, the Panthers could be thin at wide receiver behind second-year Tetairoa McMillan. With their bye week coming up in Week 5, Legette's next chance to return would be Week 6, when they travel to take on the Philadelphia Eagles.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
metadata.description: Xavier Legette (knee) didn't take part in Carolina's practice on Thursday.
metadata.analysis: Legette was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday as he continues to recover from a knee injury. It looks like he is going to be sidelined in Week 4 as a result, which will open the door for Brycen Tremayne and Darren Waller to see more work in his likely absence.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Remains sidelined Thursday
metadata.description: Legette (knee) remained a non-participant at Thursday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Legette is considered week-to-week and is trending toward a second consecutive absence Sunday night against the Lions. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity Friday to avoid being ruled out on Friday's injury report. Brycen Tremayne, John Metchie and David Moore are candidates for increased roles in a Panthers wide receiver room that may also be without Jalen Coker (quadriceps), who practiced in limited fashion Thursday after sitting out Wednesday's session.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Does Not Practice on Thursday
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette (knee) officially did not practice Thursday as the team prepares to face the Detroit Lions. Legette has now missed two straight practices due to a knee injury sustained before Week 3 and is considered "week-to-week," according to head coach Dave Canales. In two games this season, Legette has caught just two passes for 64 yards while playing just over 50% of the snaps. With Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker both standing out as Carolina's top wideouts, the former 32nd overall pick has been pushed aside because of his inconsistent play. Friday's practice will determine whether Legette can play on Sunday Night against the Lions, but he doesn't offer enough upside to be considered fantasy-relevant with McMillan and Coker emerging.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Listed as DNP on Wednesday
metadata.description: Legette (knee) did not practice Wednesday, Alex Zietlow of The Charlotte Observer reports.
metadata.analysis: Coach Dave Canales labeled Legette as week-to-week headed into Sunday night's game against the Lions. With Jalen Coker (quad) also dinged up, the Panthers could again be looking at giving Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie considerable playing time alongside Tetairoa McMillan in Detroit. Legette has a 2-64-0 receiving line on six targets across two games this season.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Xavier Legette (knee) missed Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: To no surprise, Legette was a non-participant at practice on Wednesday after missing last week's game due to a knee issue of some kind. It looks like he's trending the wrong way for Week 4, which is bad news for the Panthers, especially with Jalen Coker (quad) also uncertain to play on Sunday night.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) officially inactive for Week 3
metadata.description: Panthers WR Xavier Legette (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 3 matchup with the Browns.
metadata.analysis: Legette was a late add to the Panthers' injury report on Thursday and was limited on Friday. Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie will see increased playing time behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Inactive in Week 3
metadata.description: Legette (knee) is inactive for Sunday's game at Cleveland, Darin Gantt of the Panthers' official site reports.
metadata.analysis: Legette popped up on the Panthers' practice report Thursday as a non-participant due to a knee injury, which he followed up with a limited session Friday before being tagged as questionable to play Sunday. Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reported that Legette was expected to be a game-time decision, and Carolina has determined that a week off is prudent for the wide receiver. In Legette's absence, Brycen Tremayne, John Metchie and David Moore will be the tertiary options at the position behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker (ankle).

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Inactive Against Browns
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette (knee) is inactive for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns, according to ESPN's Adam Schefter. Legette missed Thursday's practice before returning in a limited capacity Friday and entered the weekend listed as questionable. He has two catches for 64 yards through the first two games, with both receptions coming against Atlanta last week. Jalen Coker is active after dealing with an ankle injury of his own, while John Metchie III is next up behind Legette and could see more work with him unavailable.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Hard to Trust If Active in Week 3
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette is questionable for Week 3 against Cleveland after dealing with a knee injury this week. He missed Thursday's practice, returned as a limited participant Friday, and head coach Dave Canales said Legette will be a game-time decision. Even if he plays, there is not much here for fantasy managers to lean on. Legette has two catches for 64 yards on six targets through two games, with 55 of those yards coming on one play against Atlanta. He has also played only 53% and 50% of Carolina's offensive snaps, clearly behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker. Coker is questionable with an ankle injury but is expected to play Sunday. Legette sits at WR89 in RotoBaller's updated Week 3 rankings, which fits where his role stands right now. The big play last week was encouraging, but the targets have been scarce and the knee issue adds another reason to stay away from him in most fantasy lineups.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) to likely be game-time decision Sunday
metadata.description: Xavier Legette is expected to be a game-time decision for Sunday's game against the Browns.
metadata.analysis: Legette was able to return to practice on Friday. He remains off the fantasy radar if he is cleared.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Considered game-time call
metadata.description: Legette (knee) is listed as questionable and considered a game-time decision for Sunday's matchup with Cleveland, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.
metadata.analysis: The Panthers added Legette to their injury report Thursday as a non-participant before upgrading him to limited Friday. He had a 55-yard grab in last week's blowout win over Atlanta, but Legette has been targeted on just 12 percent of his routes this season, while teammates Jalen Coker and Tetairoa McMillan both have target rates above 25 percent. If Legette is deemed inactive before the 1:00 p.m. ET kickoff, Brycen Tremayne and John Metchie will be the favorites to take on more snaps at wide receiver.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) takes part in Friday's practice
metadata.description: Xavier Legette (knee) was in action at Friday's practice session.
metadata.analysis: After sitting out the previous two days, Legette returned to the practice field Friday morning. The third-year receiver put up a goose egg in Week 1, but he hauled in 2-of-4 targets in last Sunday's blowout of the Falcons, including a 55-yard gain.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - DNP due to knee Thursday
metadata.description: Legette (knee) was listed as a non-participant at Thursday's practice.
metadata.analysis: Legette popped up on the injury report Thursday after practicing without limitations Wednesday. The 2024 first-round pick scored a 55-yard touchdown as part of a two-catch Week 2 performance against the Falcons after being held without a reception by the Bears in Week 1. Per Joe Person of The Athletic, Legette said Monday that he went for an MRI on his injury. Carolina is banged up at wide receiver behind Tetairoa McMillan, as Jalen Coker (ankle) was also sidelined Thursday.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette (knee) misses practice Wednesday
metadata.description: Xavier Legette (knee) missed Carolina's practice on Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Legette was a non-participant on Wednesday. He's dealing with a knee injury right now and was held out because of that. It remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Sunday's game, but we should know more after practice on Friday.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Hauls in 55-yard pass in Week 2 win
metadata.description: Legette caught two passes on four targets for 64 yards during the Panthers' 34-3 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Legette was held without a catch in a Week 1 loss to the Bears, when he saw only two targets from Bryce Young. Legette's targets in Week 2 doubled, and he split the Falcons' secondary to connect on a deep ball from Young for 55 yards late in the second quarter, which led to a seven-yard touchdown catch by Darren Waller three plays later. That 55-yard catch was the longest of Legette's three-year NFL career and his first reception of 40-plus yards. He'll operate as the Panthers' WR3 behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker heading into a Week 3 road tilt against the Browns on Sept. 27.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette snags deep pass in win
metadata.description: Xavier Legette caught two of four targets for 64 yards in the Panthers' 34-3 win over the Falcons on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Legette caught a huge 55-yard bomb from Bryce Young early on, but didn't get much going other than that. He's not worth starting in fantasy leagues with the majority of the work going to Tet McMillan and Jalen Coker.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Not a Trustworthy Starting WR
metadata.description: The emergence of Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker, who went off for eight catches, 138 yards and two touchdowns in the Week 1 season-opening loss to the Chicago Bears, has tanked the fantasy football value of former first-rounder Xavier Legette to open the 2026 season. In the 59-37 loss to the Bears last weekend, the 25-year-old Legette played just over half of the team's offensive snaps and failed to catch either of his two targets from quarterback Bryce Young. He added two kickoff returns on special teams for 51 yards. Legette has been a disappointment in Carolina after catching 84 of his 148 targets for 860 yards and seven touchdowns in his first two seasons, and he is clearly the WR3 for the team behind Coker and last year's first-rounder, Tetairoa McMillan. The Panthers should look to get Legette more involved in the passing attack this weekend against the division-rival Atlanta Falcons, but it is impossible to trust Legette in starting lineups right now, even in deeper formats.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Quiet outing Week 1
metadata.description: Legette failed to haul in either of his targets and returned two kickoffs for 51 yards during Carolina's loss to the Bears on Sunday.
metadata.analysis: Legette had a quiet outing despite playing 36 of the team's 68 snaps. The 2024 first-round pick will look to be more involved offensively during next week's game against the Falcons but will most likely continue to see the majority of his production come on special teams unless either Tetairoa McMillan or Jalen Coker is forced to miss time.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette sees two targets in Week 1
metadata.description: Xavier Legette failed to catch either of his two targets in the Panthers' 59-37 loss to the Chicago Bears in Week 1.
metadata.analysis: Legette failed to capitalize on his minimal involvement in the Carolina passing attack, finishing tied for fifth in targets in the loss. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 2 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette Off the Injury Report, Deep-League FLEX Vs. the Bears
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette (ankle) was not listed on the team's injury report and will suit up against the Chicago Bears in Week 1. Legette injured his ankle during practice a few weeks ago but has been cleared and will be active for the regular season opener. The 25-year-old is set to be Carolina's WR3 behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker after catching 35 passes for 363 yards and three touchdowns last season. The Bears' secondary is banged up heading into Week 1 and will be without safety Coby Bryant and cornerback Kyle Gordon. Chicago also allowed the third most fantasy points to wideouts last year, giving Legette a plus matchup for this week. Despite the positive matchup and game script (47.5 points over/under), Legette is an option in very deep leagues and is ranked WR90 in the latest RotoBaller rankings for Week 1.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Past ankle injury
metadata.description: Legette (ankle) is not listed on the Panthers' injury report Wednesday.
metadata.analysis: Legette dealt with an ankle injury last month and was in a walking boot a little over two weeks ago, but he's past the issue and ready to go for the Panthers' season opener against Chicago on Sunday. Legette is expected to open the season as the WR3 behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker. Expect the Panthers to use plenty of multiple-tight-end sets after adding Darren Waller, so that could limit Legette's playing time.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette's WR3 Role Looks Much Safer
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Xavier Legette has a clearer hold on the No. 3 role after Chris Brazzell II went down with a season-ending knee injury. Brazzell had looked good early in camp and was expected to have a role, but surgery on the LCL in his left knee ended his rookie year before it started. Legette is now listed with the first-team offense alongside Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, and Carolina held all three out of the preseason finale because their roster spots were secure. That matters after Legette slipped to 35 catches for 363 yards and three touchdowns last season. His own summer was encouraging, too. Dave Canales praised the work Legette put into the details of his game, and the former first-round pick was having a strong camp before a foot issue cost him some time late in August. He returned to practice on Sept. 1. McMillan and Coker remain ahead of him in the target pecking order, so the fantasy ceiling is still limited. The WR3 path, though, looks much cleaner than it did entering camp.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette - Remains in walking boot
metadata.description: Legette (ankle) will remain in a walking boot on his foot until Thursday, Steve Reed of the Associated Press reports.
metadata.analysis: Legette sustained an ankle injury during Wednesday's joint practice with the Jaguars, and given that he'll be in a walking boot until Thursday, he'll presumably sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Texans. When available, the 2024 first-rounder has an opportunity to claim a portion of the Panthers' WR targets that don't go to Tetairoa McMillan or Jalen Coker, a context that may not yield steady volume as long as both McMillan and Coker are available.

metadata.title: Xavier Legette to Stay in Walking Boot Until Thursday
metadata.description: Carolina Panthers head coach Dave Canales said on Monday that wide receiver Xavier Legette (ankle) will remain in a walking boot until Thursday, according to Steve Reed of The Associated Press. Legette suffered an ankle injury in last Wednesday's joint practice with the Jacksonville Jaguars and will most likely sit out the preseason finale this Friday against the Houston Texans. It is bad news as the 25-year-old looks to solidify the WR3 role in Carolina behind Tetairoa McMillan and Jalen Coker, but there is not any reason to believe that he will not be ready for the Week 1 regular-season opener in early September. The 25-year-old former first-rounder in 2024 from South Carolina has disappointed in his first two years in the NFL, catching 84 of his 148 targets for 860 yards and seven touchdowns in 31 games (25 starts). Legette regressed in 2025 with a 35-363-3 line after the team took McMillan in the first round of last year's draft. He should still have a role in the Panthers' offense in 2026 if he is healthy, but the volume is unlikely to be enough to make him rosterable in 12-team fantasy leagues.
